name: Majadas de Tiétar (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided green over yellow by three white and blue wavy stripes, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Majadas de Tiétar (a sheepfold and a pine above waves).
history: Majadas de Tiétar prepared its municipal flag to include elements important to the locality such as the sheepfold (majada), the river and the pine.

features.role: wavy stripes of white and blue between the green and the yellow
